## Summary

Describe the change, why it is needed, and any related issue or spec.

## Scope

- Affected skill, documentation, or tooling paths:

## Validation

List the exact commands or manual checks run and their results. Identify failures, skipped checks, and untested platforms. Static or synthetic checks are not native host/model evaluations. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Checklist

Check applicable items and explain anything not applicable.

- [ ] I reviewed the contribution guidance and code of conduct.
- [ ] The change is focused, preserves unrelated work, and includes a spec when required.
- [ ] Documentation and change history reflect the change.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; failures, skips, and untested behavior are stated above.
- [ ] Packages, catalogs, and generated candidates are current where affected; candidate changes do not silently promote or install skills.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, personal data, or unlicensed material are included.
- [ ] I reviewed applicable accessibility guidance, including text alternatives and meaningful links.

## Risks and follow-up

Describe breaking changes, known limitations, and any manual steps. Do not put undisclosed vulnerability details in this public PR; follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/mickpletcher/AI-Skills/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead.
